LESSON: COMMUNICATING TO

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.4: Communicating to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Communicating to. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you pray?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Communicating to
2. Give Kenyan examples for Communicating to
3. Practise Communicating to at school and at home
